subject: Hosted API evaluation — consolidate demo time / sandbox handoff
messages:
From: support@parcelloop.com
To: chloe.martin@redwood.ai
Date: 2025-10-20T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Demo request from ParcelLoop — Hosted API eval signup

Hi team,

We just signed up for the Hosted API eval and I was routed to your team. Our lead engineer (Kayla) is keen to walk through a short (30m) evaluation focusing on low-latency batch generation and embeddings throughput. She mentioned getting sandbox access and a quick-housekeeping session.

Company: ParcelLoop
Use case: fulfilment summarization + product matching (embedding pipeline)
Preferred window: mornings PST next week

Thanks — can someone from SDR/PLG coordinate?

— ParcelLoop Support (auto-forward)
From: dylan_brooks@redwood.ai
To: Kayla Moreno <kayla@parcelloop.com>, chloe.martin@redwood.ai
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.ai
Date: 2025-10-20T10:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Demo request from ParcelLoop — Hosted API eval signup

Hi Kayla — welcome! I'm Dylan on the SDR/PLG team. Thanks for signing up. 

I can run a 30-minute walkthrough next week. Proposed slots (PST):
- Tue 10/21 9:30–10:00am
- Wed 10/22 11:00–11:30am
- Thu 10/23 8:30–9:00am

Are any of these good? If not, send a couple windows and we'll match. I can also invite an engineer from our side for the embeddings discussion — tagging Ben who owns sandbox provisioning.

Next steps I can take after we lock time:
- Provision a short-lived sandbox (API key + sample dataset)
- Share a 15-min pre-demo checklist so you can confirm sample queries

Cheers,
Dylan
SDR, Redwood Inference
From: Kayla Moreno <kayla@parcelloop.com>
To: dylan_brooks@redwood.ai, chloe.martin@redwood.ai
Date: 2025-10-20T12:13:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Demo request from ParcelLoop — Hosted API eval signup

Hi Dylan — thanks for the quick reply. Wed 11:00–11:30am PT works best for our team — that gives us time after standup to pull the dataset. Can you include an invite with dial-in and the sandbox invite?

Also, heads-up: our security team may ask for a short list of data retention details during the call. If Ben can share the retention defaults for Hosted API during the walkthrough, that would be great.

— Kayla
Lead Engineer, ParcelLoop
From: ben_carter@redwood.ai

On Mon, Oct 20, 2025 at 12:13 PM Kayla Moreno <kayla@parcelloop.com> wrote:
> Hi Dylan — thanks for the quick reply. Wed 11:00–11:30am PT works best for our team — that gives us time after standup to pull the dataset. Can you include an invite with dial-in and the sandbox invite?
>
> Also, heads-up: our security team may ask for a short list of data retention details during the call. If Ben can share the retention defaults for Hosted API during the walkthrough, that would be great.

Thanks Kayla — happy to join Wednesday. Quick notes before the meeting: 
- Retention: default session logs retained 7 days; you can opt-out of logging per request header. I'll bring the short slide with retention/PII controls and KMS options.
- Sandbox: I'll kick off provisioning after Dylan posts the confirmed time. The sandbox will include a temporary API key (scope: generate, embeddings) and a small sample dataset we host.

I'll attach the quickstart guide and drop an .ics once Dylan confirms.

Attachments: redwood-quickstart.pdf

Cheers,
Ben Carter
Platform Engineer, Redwood Inference
From: dylan_brooks@redwood.ai
To: Kayla Moreno <kayla@parcelloop.com>, ben_carter@redwood.ai, chloe.martin@redwood.ai
Date: 2025-10-21T16:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Demo request from ParcelLoop — Hosted API eval signup

Great — Wed 2025-10-22 11:00–11:30 AM PT confirmed and calendar invite sent (sandbox-invite.ics attached). Ben, thanks for the retention note.

Kayla — quick checklist ahead of Wed: 
1) Confirm a sample of ~200 product descriptions (CSV) — this helps us show embedding nearest-neighbor performance.
2) Let us know any IP/PII constraints so we can run the demo against sanitized data if needed.
3) If security will join, we can reserve 10 extra minutes for retention/KMS Q&A.

I'm sending the calendar invite now and a short Drive doc with pre-demo steps: https://drive.redwood.ai/rdw/quickstart/parcelloop-guide

See you Wednesday — dialing info is in the invite.

Dylan
SDR, Redwood Inference
